podcast.title: Death Details - November 24, 2024 (Approx.)
podcast.body: Bob Bryar was last seen alive on November 4th, 2024. He was found dead in his Tennessee home on November 26th, with the coroner indicating he likely died two days prior. The cause of his death was never publicly released. "He was last seen alive on November 4th. And he was found dead in his Tennessee home on November 26th, apparently having died two days earlier. That's what the corner said anyway. And no cause of death was ever released."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Absence from 2025 Reunion Tour
podcast.body: Despite My Chemical Romance planning a 2025 reunion tour in stadiums, Bob Bryar will not be participating with the band. "My chemical romance has a 2025 reunion tour planned. Stadiums. But Bob will not be with them."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Post-Music Career
podcast.body: After leaving My Chemical Romance, Bryar became a real estate agent and dedicated his time to supporting dog rescue charities. "Now for that, he became a real estate agent and devoted his time to dog rescue charities."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Tenure with My Chemical Romance
podcast.body: Bob Bryar served as the drummer for My Chemical Romance for a significant period, from their second album in 2004 until the band's breakup in 2013. "He stayed with the band all the way until their breakup in 2013."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
